prompt: Full front from the counter on a 40mm lens, slightly above eye level: a man of about seventy-five with a long, deep-lined face lies back in a chrome barber's chair, shaving lather on one jaw only, his lips clear, a towel folded low on his chest, head and shoulders large in frame. Behind him the plate window of the shop has just burst inward, a storm of glass hanging in the air, a black 1920s sedan stopped at the kerb beyond it with its lamps glaring. Bottles of tonic have burst along the shelf beside him. A sea-green lamp lights his face from the front; a coral red street lamp glows through the broken window. The chrome headrest and footplate carry long curved reflections of both. Thanks.
